gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-asap: Loose and hand-drawn, Lugrasimo greets you warmly while Asap's open-arc c forms and tall lowercase keep things grounded. Handwritten warmth up top, straightforward sans clarity underneath, with nothing fighting for attention.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Crisp and unfussy, the text below runs in plain sans strokes that bend like steel rod, under Lugrasimo's loose handwriting. Be Vietnam Pro keeps its curve ends apart, so text stays open.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-epilogue: Approachable from the first word, Lugrasimo's loose handwriting sits over Epilogue, a sans with curvy, tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascenders. Hand-drawn looseness above, wire-like monoline strokes below keep the page moving.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads wide and plain, its s curves opening at both ends, while Lugrasimo's gentle dip-pen variation hovers above. Mostly it is a gap between handwriting and pen-plotter smoothness.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-literata: Lugrasimo gives the heading a hand-drawn, inviting looseness, with curves that never clot where they turn. And Literata does the bookish work below, its classic serif curves leaving their mouths unclosed.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-merriweather-sans: Sturdy and large-looking, Merriweather Sans opens its e clearly to the right, set beneath Lugrasimo's loose handwritten line. Paragraphs of this sans-serif should feel steady all the way down.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-public-sans: Lugrasimo writes the heading in a friendly, hand-drawn line, loose and spread out across the top. Public Sans holds the text underneath, hefty and trustworthy, its sans-serif counters broad and generous.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-ranade: Lugrasimo brings a loose, hand-drawn friendliness up top, while Ranade below shifts its weight only slightly, like stretched rubber cord. Give Ranade a bit more size, since its widely spaced letters take room.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-sentient: Sentient, classic serif in spirit, pinches its apertures shut and thins its crossbars, made for brief sittings. Sentient stays tight and closed where Lugrasimo's handwriting runs open, loose and friendly.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-supreme: Loose meets crisp: Lugrasimo is best at hand-drawn, inviting friendliness up top, with loose spread-out lines. Supreme handles the crisp, heavy-looking text, its letters held open rather than curled shut.
